source: Pins the shape of interface AvailabilityEntry from @kiosinc/commons-types types/availabilityTypes.ts (kiosinc/kios-commons-types#74) as declared in src/domain/services/AvailabilityEntryService.ts. updatedAt is the Admin SDK Timestamp here (FirestoreTimestampLike in commons-types). Contract: kiosinc/restaurant-core-claude#162 §1 as amended 2026-09-03. A contract change lands in commons-types, the rcc declaration, and this snapshot together. PENDING 2026-09-10 (rcc#221): the third kind 'optionSet' has NOT shipped in the @kiosinc/commons-types mirror yet — this snapshot and the rcc declaration lead it. Widening the mirror is required follow-up work originating in rcc#221, and it is two edits, not one: the AvailabilityEntryKind union in types/availabilityTypes.ts, and the AssertExact pin in type-tests/availabilityTypes.test-d.ts that currently closes that union at two members. No issue for it existed when this line was written, so this string, not an issue, is the record. Until that mirror ships, this snapshot pins the rcc declaration alone for the kind member.
